Lovely..|audio = ContainmentWave20-2.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 20 ([[Containment]])}} {{QuoteBox|I MUST SAY, IT'S ASTONISHING HOW OFTEN YOUR ORGANIZATION KEEPS GETTING PLAYED INTO OUR HANDS, AND IF YOU THINK THIS WHOLE SITUATION CAN BE RESOLVED, WELL YOU'LL FIND OUT SOON THAT YOU CAN'T STOP WHAT'S COMING!|audio = ContainmentWave20-3.ogg|[[Titus (Narrator)|Corrupted Titus]] on Wave 20 ([[Containment]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Corrupted Titus''' is the final boss of [[Nil Zone II]] in [[Halloween 2026 Live Events]], and previously appeared as a major boss in [[Containment]] as part of the [[Hexscape Event]]. It is the corrupted version of [[Titus]]; thus, its abilities are stronger. It has high health and a slightly slow speed. It renames itself to '''Big Titus''' via glitch effects on its boss HP bar. It has two abilities. The first is ''Void Stream'', targeting towers in proximity, diminishing them with a 60% [[Firerate Debuff]] (150% increase) and regenerating 10 health per tower inflicted. Its second ability was ''Dark Decoy'', whichs summon five [[Neuro Runner]]s and five [[Bloated]] [[Brain Bound]]s, all with a 0.2-second delay between each spawn; in addition, it also temporarily gains [[Aggro]] and [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] attribute, and a permanent 5% defense increase. ==Appearance== '''Corrupted Titus''' has grey skin, with part of its face being purple with neon purple veins. Its right arm was replaced with a mechanical arm, and has three claws and a laser blaster around the gauntlet. It has grey hair. It wears a grey shirt and blue pants, and dark brown shoes. On its left arm, it has a metal shoulder-pad, multiple brown bandages and a brown glove with black brass knuckles with spikes. It also wore a grey bandana. On its torso, it has a large brown belt attached to a brown armor piece that protects its mechanical arm and to the torso. It has a brown belt with pouches and a grey plate with "''CRR6PT''" engraved on it. It also had grey knee-pads. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Ranger]], [[Engineer]] or [[Accelerator]] are recommended against this. The [[Juggernaut]] and [[Kingpin]] given as part of the preset loadouts during the 2026 Nil Zone event are also highly effective. **Support towers like the [[Commander]] or [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost their statistics. The [[Commander]] can also be used to partially mitigate its [[Firerate Debuff]]. *While defense dropping towers, like the [[Pyromancer]] or [[DJ Booth]], can be used to drop its defense, this is not necessary as it is not that high, resulting in a minimal DPS increase. *As it is a [[Boss]] enemy, it is significantly harder to slow down as multiple of its immunities either reduce effectiveness of the slowdown or prevent it entirely. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center" style{{=}}"width:750px; margin:0 auto;" |- ! colspan{{=}}"2" |Death |- |[[File:TitusDeath.ogg]] |When '''Corrupted Titus''' dies |} }}}} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} Halloween2026LiveEventThumbnail.png|'''Corrupted Titus''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Cutscenes}} Night 2 Cutscenes - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Corrupted Titus''' in the [[Banlands]] cutscene. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} CorruptedTtitusFace.png|'''Corrupted Titus's''' face. }} ==Trivia== *The belt of '''Corrupted Titus''' wore had the nameplate "''CRR6PT''", which is a wordplay on the word "''corrupt''". *'''Corrupted Titus''' was added to pay homage to the unused Corrupted [[Penumbras]] enemy that was intended for [[The Great Finale]]https://x.com/BelowNatural/status/1930306665053573418. ==Update History== *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Corrupted Titus''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping towers now can drop its defense. **{{Bug}} '''Corrupted Titus''' receives damage at rapid speed from unit collision, if the damage dealt is to its healed health. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **'''Corrupted Titus''' can no longer have its defense decreased. **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping towers now can drop its defense if it is not a [[Boss]] enemy, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Corrupted Titus''' removed. *'''25 September 2026''' - [[v2.11.0|v2.11.2]] **'''Corrupted Titus''' re-added. ==Notes== {{Containment|[[Hex Drako]]|Wave 19|Corrupted Titus & [[Nightmarish Hulk]]|Wave 20|[[Hex Weaver]]|Wave 22}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]]
